payload.name: Xi'an — 2 Days + Arrival Evening
payload.description: A Bell Tower–based Xi’an section with an easy food-focused arrival night, a linked full-day tour and performance, then the City Wall, museums and Tang-themed evening.

destinations.name: Xi'an
destinations.description: Stay near the Bell Tower for a highly central base close to the Drum Tower, Muslim Quarter, metro connections and the City Wall.

activities.title: Bell Tower & Drum Tower at dusk
activities.notes: Watch the sunset light reach the ancient structures and stay as the evening illumination begins.

activities.title: Muslim Quarter walking dinner
activities.notes:
Explore the heart of Xi’an’s food scene as a walking dinner rather than choosing only one restaurant.
• Roujiamo
• Yangrou paomo
• Biangbiang noodles
• Sour plum juice

activities.title: Drum Tower Square night atmosphere
activities.notes: Enjoy the illuminated tower and surrounding night atmosphere after dinner.

activities.title: Optional South Gate night view
activities.notes: See the spectacularly lit City Wall from the square. There is no need to go onto the wall tonight because the full ride is planned later.

days.title: Booked Xi’an day tour & palace performance

activities.title: Xi’an full-day tour booking
activities.notes: Use the supplied Trip.com booking page for the exact meeting point, pickup, inclusions and final itinerary. Confirm all details before travel.

activities.title: Song of Everlasting Sorrow
activities.notes: Pair the full-day tour with the Song of Everlasting Sorrow evening performance. Confirm the seasonal showtime and return transport.

days.title: City Wall, museums & Tang Dynasty night

activities.title: Cycle the complete Xi’an City Wall
activities.notes:
Rent a bicycle and ride the complete 14 km loop for the strongest contrast between old and new Xi’an.
• Allow 1.5–2 hours riding time
• Start early
• Enter near South Gate

activities.title: Muslim Quarter lunch
activities.notes:
Return for favourites or try anything missed on the arrival evening.
• Roujiamo
• Yangrou paomo
• Biangbiang noodles

activities.title: Shaanxi History Museum
activities.notes:
Explore the world-class Tang murals, gold artefacts and regional history collection. Tickets should be reserved days in advance.
• Book early
• Tang Dynasty murals
• Gold artefacts

activities.title: Great Wild Goose Pagoda
activities.notes: Visit the iconic pagoda and walk the surrounding square; check whether a fountain show fits the day.

activities.title: Grand Tang Mall Everbright Zone
activities.notes:
Walk the 2.1 km theatrical pedestrian zone for a spectacular Tang Dynasty fantasy atmosphere. A slower visit can take 3–4 hours.
• 2.1 km pedestrian street
• Street performances
• Tang-inspired lighting and staging

activities.title: Legend of the Camel Bell
activities.notes:
This is the priority show for the second evening. Allow about 30 minutes by taxi or Didi from the city centre.
• Absolutely worth it
• Book the 7:00 PM show
• Allow 30 min transfer

activities.title: Tang Palace / Empress Wu show
activities.notes: Lower priority than Legend of the Camel Bell. Skip it, or only add it if a cheap option fits without crowding the schedule.

activities.title: Optional final Xi’an stops
activities.notes:
Use any remaining time for one compact extra rather than rushing all of them.
• Small Wild Goose Pagoda
• Xi’an Museum
• Last-minute souvenirs
• Revisit Muslim Quarter favourites

stays.name: Check into Bell Tower area hotel
stays.notes: A central hotel saves travel time and keeps the first evening’s sights within an easy walk.

payload.name: Chengdu — 2 Days + Arrival Evening
payload.description: A central-Chengdu base with an easy arrival night, one culture-and-city day, and a panda plus Leshan day before continuing to Xi’an.

destinations.name: Chengdu
destinations.description: Stay around Tianfu Square, Taikoo Li or Chunxi Road for a walkable base with strong metro connections.

days.title: Arrive by 5 PM & Chengdu after dark

activities.title: Arrive in Chengdu & transfer to hotel
activities.notes: Take a taxi or metro to a hotel near Tianfu Square, Taikoo Li, Chunxi Road or Kuanzhai Alley, then check in and rest.

activities.title: IFC selfie panda
activities.notes: Stop for the famous climbing-panda statue and city photos before the night walk.

activities.title: Chunxi Road & Taikoo Li night walk
activities.notes:
Take an easy first-night walk through the bright shopping streets, photograph Taikoo Li after dark and have dinner nearby.
• Chunxi Road
• Taikoo Li night photography
• Dinner
• Keep the evening relaxed

days.title: Old lanes, tea culture & city lights

activities.title: Kuanzhai Alleys & traditional dress photos
activities.notes:
Explore the restored Qing-era Wide and Narrow Alleys, try local snacks and rent traditional clothing for a modern-and-traditional Chengdu photo session.
• Traditional dress rental
• Photos in the old lanes
• Snacks and boutiques
• Return the clothes later

activities.title: People’s Park & Heming Teahouse
activities.notes:
Slow down in Renmin Park among dancing and mahjong, then have tea at the well-known Heming Teahouse.
• Garden walk
• Watch local mahjong
• Tea at Heming Teahouse

activities.title: Taikoo Li bookshops & design stops
activities.notes:
Return toward Taikoo Li for the spiral-walkway Zhong Shuge Bookstore, Fang Suo Commune bookshop café and the Tower of Life.
• Zhong Shuge spiral walkway
• Fang Suo Commune café
• Tower of Life
• Taikoo Li shopping street

place.name: Taikoo Li and nearby central Chengdu

activities.title: Dinner at Jinli Ancient Street
activities.notes:
Try a small selection of Chengdu favourites before the evening show.
• Dan dan noodles
• Spicy rabbit head
• Sweet rice-wine balls

activities.title: Sichuan Opera face-changing show
activities.notes: Watch the classic face-changing performance from approximately 7:30–9:00 PM.

activities.title: Tianfu Twin Towers light show
activities.notes: If timing and energy allow, finish with the Beacons of Light display, then return early because the next morning’s tour pickup is early.

activities.title: Chengdu Panda Base guided visit
activities.notes:
Use the guided pickup for an early visit while the pandas are most active, then return toward Chengdu around midday.
• A$62 tour estimate
• Early pickup
• Morning panda activity

place.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding

activities.title: Quick lunch before Leshan
activities.notes: Keep lunch efficient so there is enough time for the train and the Leshan scenic area.

place.name: Chengdu East Railway Station or Panda Base area

activities.title: Chengdu → Leshan
activities.notes: On arrival, take a 10–15 minute taxi from Leshan Station to the Giant Buddha scenic area.

activities.title: Leshan Giant Buddha
activities.notes:
Explore the cliffside site and, if conditions and timing work, add the boat ride for the full-body river view.
• Cliff path beside the Buddha
• See the rivers meet
• Boat ride for full-body view

activities.title: Leshan → Chengdu
activities.notes: Taxi back to Leshan Station and take the high-speed train to Chengdu.

activities.title: Final Chengdu evening
activities.notes:
Have dinner near the hotel, then choose a gentle city walk, Chengdu vintage shops or a large bookstore before resting.
• Dinner near the hotel
• Vintage shops
• Largest bookstore option
• Tianfu Square or Chunxi Road walk

place.name: Taikoo Li / Tianfu Square / Chunxi Road

activities.title: Next morning: Chengdu → Xi’an
activities.notes: Leave Chengdu in the morning for Xi’an. Keep the night before light and confirm the station, train time and hotel checkout arrangements.

stays.name: Central Chengdu hotel

place.name: Tianfu Square / Taikoo Li / Chunxi Road

stays.notes: Choose a walkable hotel close to the metro for easy city sightseeing and the early guided-tour pickup.

payload.name: Chongqing — 2 Nights / 2.5 Days
payload.description: A Jiefangbei-based city section covering the Hongyadong lights, mountain-city neighbourhoods, cable cars and a Saturday-night drone-show option.

destinations.name: Chongqing
destinations.description: Base yourself in Jiefangbei CBD for easy access to Hongyadong, Chaotianmen, the cable car and central metro lines.

activities.title: Arrive in Chongqing & check in
activities.notes: Reach Chongqing around 4:00 PM and check into a hotel in the Jiefangbei area before the evening photography route.

activities.title: Raffles City ground-level walk
activities.notes: Take a low-commitment ground-level walk and a few photos before moving into position for the lights.

activities.title: Qiansimen Bridge blue-hour position
activities.notes:
Be on the bridge before the city lights switch on. Stay through blue hour and until the bridge itself is illuminated around 8:00 PM.
• Hongyadong lights around 7:30 PM May–September
• Golden photo window: first 30 minutes
• Bridge lights around 8:00 PM
• Expect heavy crowds

activities.title: Grand Theatre riverbank reflections
activities.notes:
Walk across to the opposite riverbank for the highest-priority photo angle: the full Hongyadong building, bridge and water reflection with fewer crowds.
• Priority photo spot #1
• Full building and bridge
• Best immediately after lights-on

place.name: Grand Theatre side of the river

activities.title: Explore Hongyadong’s 11 levels
activities.notes:
After seeing the complex from across the river, go inside and finish at the first-floor looking-up angle. The levels are generally active until around 11:00 PM.
• Priority photo spot #3
• Look up from Level 1
• Very crowded after lights-on

activities.title: Yangtze River night cruise or drone show
activities.notes:
Choose the river cruise, or prioritise the Saturday-night drone show when scheduled. Confirm the current operating notice and viewing location.
• Drone show: every Saturday night
• May–September around 9:00 PM
• October–April around 8:30 PM
• Verify timing before travel

activities.title: Guide or driver recommended
activities.notes:
A guide or driver is highly recommended for this full urban day. The goal is a logical geographic flow through Chongqing’s culture and famously layered terrain.
• Best scheduled on a weekday
• Wear shoes for hills and stairs
• Keep metro and taxi options flexible

activities.title: Eling Second Factory
activities.notes: Start with morning coffee and photos at this trendy hilltop creative area before it becomes crowded.

activities.title: Yangtze River Cable Car — north to south
activities.notes: Taxi from Eling to the north-side cable-car station and ride one way across the Yangtze for the changing skyline views.

activities.title: Ciqikou Old Town & lunch
activities.notes:
Spend about 1.5 hours among the alleys, tea houses and snack shops, then have lunch before continuing.
• Historic alleys
• Tea houses
• Local snacks
• Lunch in Ciqikou

activities.title: Liziba train-through-building viewpoint
activities.notes: Use Metro Line 1 and transfer to Line 2, then watch the monorail pass directly through the residential building.

activities.title: Arhat Temple
activities.notes: Return toward the city centre for a serene historic contrast to the surrounding modern metropolis.

activities.title: Jiefangbei & Chaotianmen night walk
activities.notes:
Have dinner, then enjoy a flexible night walk through the central business district and Chaotianmen riverfront.
• Jiefangbei pedestrian area
• Chaotianmen skyline
• Dinner nearby
• Extra Chongqing photo opportunities

activities.title: Shancheng Mountain City Trail
activities.notes:
Walk the most scenic northern section through old neighbourhoods, staircases and alleyways for the real mountain-city atmosphere.
• Historic pedestrian path
• Old neighbourhood stairs
• Stop after the best 1–1.5 hour section

place.name: Northern section near Jiefangbei and Raffles City

activities.title: Yangtze Cable Car — north to south
activities.notes: Take the opposite direction to the earlier ride for a different approach and skyline perspective.

activities.title: Nanbin Road riverfront & lunch
activities.notes: Stroll the south-bank promenade for broad CBD skyline views, then have lunch before collecting luggage.

activities.title: Leave Chongqing
activities.notes: Return for luggage and aim to leave Chongqing around 3:00 PM.

stays.name: Jiefangbei CBD hotel
stays.notes: Stay centrally for easy night walks and quick access to Hongyadong, Chaotianmen and the river crossings.

payload.name: Zhangjiajie 5-Day Itinerary
payload.description: Four nights based in Wulingyuan, followed by Fenghuang Ancient Town. Avoid weekends. Working budget: A$1,000, or about A$700 with a guided-tour allocation.

destinations.name: Wulingyuan
destinations.description: The practical base for Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Baofeng Lake and the Grand Canyon.

destinations.name: Fenghuang
destinations.description: A lantern-lit ancient town on the Tuojiang River, ideal for a slow afternoon and full riverside evening.

activities.title: Trip plan, budget & weekend warning
activities.notes:
Do not schedule the major park days on a weekend. Working trip budget is A$1,000; allow roughly A$700 if using a guided tour.
• Avoid weekends
• A$1,000 working budget
• A$700 guided-tour allocation

activities.title: Zhangjiajie Airport → Wulingyuan
activities.notes: Arrive by 8:00 PM and transfer directly to the hotel in Wulingyuan.

activities.title: Xibu Street & Suoxiyu riverside walk
activities.notes:
If energy allows, get a first taste of Wulingyuan at its main night spot and take a gentle walk beside the river.
• Xibu Street
• Suoxiyu River
• Keep the first night easy

activities.title: Golden Whip Stream
activities.notes:
Taxi or walk to the Forest Park East Gate, then take the eco-bus to the Golden Whip Stream area. Walk a peaceful section rather than forcing the full length.
• Clear water and dramatic cliffs
• Quiet forest trail
• Possible monkey sightings
• Finish around noon

activities.title: Hotel rest and reset
activities.notes: Return to the hotel for lunch, rest and a refresh before the lighter afternoon.

activities.title: Baofeng Lake boat ride
activities.notes: Take the short scenic boat ride, then return to Wulingyuan with time to rest before the evening.

activities.title: Wulingyuan night vibe
activities.notes:
Dinner, an unhurried Xibu Street stroll and the riverside walk. A foot massage is an optional finish.
• Dinner in Wulingyuan
• Xibu Street
• Suoxiyu riverside
• Optional foot massage

activities.title: Charming Xiangxi Show
activities.notes: Evening performance scheduled for approximately 7:20–9:00 PM. Reserve tickets in advance.

activities.title: Bailong Elevator & Yuanjiajie
activities.notes:
Enter early via the Forest Park East Gate, take the eco-bus to Bailong Elevator and ride to Yuanjiajie’s top platform.
• Hallelujah Mountain
• First Bridge Under Heaven
• Enchanting Platform
• Back Garden

activities.title: Tianzi Mountain viewpoints
activities.notes:
Take the 20–30 minute eco-bus from Yuanjiajie and explore the headline viewpoints.
• Imperial Brush Peak
• Helong Park
• Fairy Peaks
• Sea of Clouds if weather allows

activities.title: Ten-Mile Gallery scenic train
activities.notes:
Eco-bus down to Ten-Mile Gallery at the base of Tianzi Mountain, then use the mini scenic train for the rock formations.
• Old Man Gathering Herbs
• Three Sisters Peak
• Mini scenic train

activities.title: Return to Wulingyuan & recover
activities.notes:
Eco-bus out and taxi back to the hotel, aiming to arrive around 4–5 PM. Rest; a foot massage or spa is strongly recommended after the park day.
• Early dinner
• Rest tired legs
• Optional foot massage or spa

activities.title: Grand Canyon Glass Bridge
activities.notes:
Taxi 25–30 minutes from Wulingyuan. Enter around 9:00 AM, cross the bridge and take photos; skip the canyon hike to protect the afternoon.
• Bridge entry 9:00–10:30
• Skip canyon hike
• Leave for the city by 10:30

activities.title: Grand Canyon → Zhangjiajie City
activities.notes: Transfer to the city and fit in a quick lunch before noon.

activities.title: Tianmen Mountain west route
activities.notes:
Cable car to the summit, follow the scenic West Route, descend by escalator to Heaven’s Gate and take the shuttle down the 99-bend road.
• Glass Skywalk
• Ghost Valley Glass Path
• Cliff paths
• Tianmen Cave
• 99-bend Road

activities.title: Zhangjiajie City evening options
activities.notes:
Choose a late dinner and taxi back to Wulingyuan, or add one city-night activity if energy allows.
• Lishui River Promenade
• City food streets
• 72 Strange Buildings
• Tujia Folk Custom Park
• Optional Tianmen Fox Fairy Show 8:00–9:30 PM

activities.title: Leave Wulingyuan for Fenghuang
activities.notes: Leave Wulingyuan around 8:00 AM, connect to Fenghuang, then have lunch and rest before exploring.

activities.title: Fenghuang old town walk
activities.notes:
Follow the main riverside path and old lanes at an easy pace.
• Cross Hong Bridge
• Shiban Street
• Shen Congwen Former Residence
• Yang Family Ancestral Hall

activities.title: Nanhua Bridge sunset & lantern hour
activities.notes: Use Nanhua Bridge for sunset and stay as thousands of lanterns transform the riverfront into the evening scene.

activities.title: Tuojiang River night cruise
activities.notes:
See the illuminated stilt houses from the water, then complete the full riverside night walk.
• Approx. ¥168
• Glowing stilt houses
• Full riverside night walk — must do

activities.title: Optional extension: mist walk, Furong or Chongqing
activities.notes:
If adding a sixth day, take a quiet morning mist walk and slow breakfast, then continue by train to Chongqing (about four hours). Furong Ancient Town is another optional add-on via a short train connection.
• Traditional Miao dress photos are best in Fenghuang
• Allow one more day for a relaxed Fenghuang stay

stays.name: Wulingyuan hotel base
stays.notes: Use one Wulingyuan hotel as the base for Nights 1–4 to minimise packing and daily transfers.

payload.name: Guilin & Yangshuo — 3 Days
payload.description: Three scenic days connecting Guilin’s riverfront landmarks and caves with the Li River cruise, Yangshuo, Ten-Mile Gallery and an optional Longji alternative.

destinations.name: Guilin
destinations.description: A compact riverside city of limestone hills, illuminated lakes and caves that works well as the gateway to the Li River.

destinations.name: Yangshuo
destinations.description: Karst countryside best explored slowly by Li River cruise, e-bike and bamboo raft, with an overnight near the river.

activities.title: Elephant Trunk Hill
activities.notes: Start at Guilin’s signature Li River landmark, where the limestone hill resembles an elephant drinking from the water.

activities.title: Two Rivers and Four Lakes walk
activities.notes: Walk an easy daylight section of the connected river-and-lake system before lunch.

place.name: Two Rivers and Four Lakes Scenic Area

activities.title: Reed Flute Cave
activities.notes: Explore the large stalactite and stalagmite formations illuminated with coloured lighting.

activities.title: Fubo Hill or Diecai Hill viewpoint
activities.notes:
Choose one hill for a panoramic city view rather than rushing both.
• Fubo Hill — riverside setting
• Diecai Hill — broader elevated views

activities.title: Two Rivers and Four Lakes night cruise
activities.notes: See Guilin’s bridges, pagodas and waterfront illuminated from the water.

activities.title: Guilin rice noodles & beer fish
activities.notes: Finish with Guilin rice noodles and try beer fish if it fits the group’s appetite.

activities.title: Li River cruise — Guilin to Yangshuo
activities.notes:
Cruise through the classic karst landscape, including Nine Horse Fresco Hill and Xingping scenery represented on the ¥20 note.
• Departs around 9:00 AM
• Karst mountain scenery
• Nine Horse Fresco Hill
• Xingping / ¥20 note view

activities.title: Rent an electric bike
activities.notes: Collect an e-bike and confirm the battery range, lock and return time before leaving town.

activities.title: Ride the Ten-Mile Gallery
activities.notes: Ride the on-land scenic road through Yangshuo’s karst countryside with time for photo stops.

activities.title: West Street evening
activities.notes: Explore West Street for local snacks, casual dinner and shopping before the river show.

activities.title: Impression Liu Sanjie
activities.notes: Watch the famous large-scale outdoor river performance directed by Zhang Yimou. Confirm the seasonal showtime.

activities.title: Morning e-bike ride
activities.notes: Rent or retain an e-bike for the countryside approach to the Yulong River and nearby Ten-Mile Gallery sections.

activities.title: Yulong River bamboo raft — Option 06
activities.notes:
Take the selected short bamboo-raft route, then continue through the surrounding countryside.
• Option 06
• About 50 minutes
• Approx. ¥200
• Pairs with Ten-Mile Gallery

activities.title: Check Yangshuo helicopter tours
activities.notes: Optional: check current helicopter-tour availability, weather rules, operating times and pricing before committing.

activities.title: Alternative: Longji Rice Terraces day
activities.notes:
Choose this instead of the Yulong River and e-bike plan if the rice terraces are the higher priority. Do not attempt both routes on the same day.
• Alternative plan — not an add-on
• Allow a full day
• Confirm transfer time from Yangshuo or Guilin

stays.name: Check into Yangshuo stay
stays.notes: Leave luggage at a Yangshuo hotel or riverside guesthouse before exploring by e-bike.
